dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $S(G)$ be the set of all stable sets of a digraph $G$ and $S(G,v)$ the stable sets containing $v$. A fractional majority colouring assigns each $T \in S(G)$ a weight $x_T \geq 0$ such that $\sum_{T \in S(G,v)} x_T \geq 1$ for each vertex $v$. What is the minimum $k$ such that every digraph $G$ has a fractional majority colouring with $\sum_{T \in S(G)} x_T \leq k$? Perhaps $k < 3$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This fractional relaxation of majority colouring is introduced in Section 5 as a natural variant. The informal conjecture that the minimum total weight is less than 3 would constitute a fractional analogue of Conjecture 2.
